title: Talbot, Depass and band members from Crystal Palace days
summary: Talk of Elmer Talbot's family, Mrs. Depass's interview, and a band with Edna Francis, Cuckoo, Big Ike and Benny Benoit on banjo.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: I always had his music rack right up there in his office. That's right, that's correct. Speaking of dentists, this morning I rode up the Tulane with Joe Robichaux and he mentioned that Elmer Talbot's brother is a dentist.
Yeah, well I told you that, Chad.

Yeah, Dr. Talbot. Yeah, I'd forgotten. Well that's his nephew that worked with me at Lykes, Arnold Depass, the son of old man Depass, you all interviewed his mother. Yes, he told me, he said someday if I want he'll write it down, story about Talbot, what he's called, Cuckoo. He used to play trumpet and maybe some things about his daddy that his mother wanted. Yeah, we were talking about him. You know he'll write it down for me because I'm...
Get him to get the family together or anything.
Well you all interviewed him already. No, who? You all interviewed his mother, Mrs. Depass. Maybe Dick. Well maybe Dick, huh? Yeah, we did. Yeah, well Dick did.
Yeah, well Dick, cause Dick told... Maybe that's right.

Cause she told Dick about when I, when we was playing at the Crystal Palace everybody would bring me a beer and give it to him and when they bring him ice cream he'd give it to me. Oh yeah, you told us that too. Yeah, well she told Dick about that. Yeah.
And then I guess Dick I forgot. I don't hear those other interviews and we get so many of them sometime I don't know.

Yeah, she gave them good interviews because she remember all them old times and remember the names and everything so good. That's good. Because her son told me that it surprised him. She remember like Edna used to play piano, Edna Francis, Alvin Francis' wife was playing trumpet, the one called Cuckoo, I never didn't know he was right, and Big Ike was playing trombone, Big Ike was on Clairvon, he's not playing anymore.
No we missed that talk to him I've been talking about. Robinson.
Yeah. And Benny Benoit was playing banjo, well I see him every day, he can't talk too well, but I told him, we might interview him one time, that's Saiz Bredelaw.
See because if he lived with his sister she could remember a lot of stuff. He was a very good banjo player. He was playing with me at the Five Island again, see you see. Very good banjo player.
